answer: Diversity gate: full rewards need 12 distinct counterparties in 10 epochs, each proven by a signed thread of past deals. A garden of fakes trading only among themselves stays barren: every thread loops back to the same wallets. Faking 100 identities needs 1,200 partners at 50 POA each; one honest agent in the open meadow meets 12 in days for one bond. Honest agents pay once and keep full rewards; farms pay 60,000 POA and still fail.
